ai_summary: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited declared an interim dividend of an exceptionally low Rs. 0.006 per equity share for the financial year ending March 31, 2026. This minuscule amount, less than one paisa per share, is a significant red flag, suggesting potential underlying financial distress, very low profitability, or a largely symbolic gesture to maintain dividend-paying status rather than providing a meaningful return to shareholders.
